about.t015: State-of-the-art workshop first opened in Medan, North Sumatra
about.t005: Built on Engineering Excellence and Exceptional After-Sales Service
about.t006: PT. Numalos Abadi is a specialised engineering company representing Flottweg SE (Germany), a global leader and pioneer in decanter centrifuge technology. Flottweg has an established presence in Indonesia’s palm oil industry, as well as across a wide range of other industrial applications.
about.t017: A comprehensive renovation of our office and workshop to accommodate the growing number of Flottweg machines operating across Indonesia and further strengthen our after-sales service capabilities.
about.t007:
Established in 1990, PT. Numalos Abadi was founded with a clear commitment to delivering specialised engineering solutions and exceptional after-sales service to support the brands it represents and the customers it serves.

In response to growing demand and our commitment to providing the highest level of customer support, we established a fully equipped workshop featuring state-of-the-art machinery at our headquarters in Kawasan Industri Medan (KIM), North Sumatra, in 1994. The workshop underwent a comprehensive renovation in 2019, further strengthening our capabilities to deliver reliable maintenance, repair, and technical support services to our customers.
about.t019: More than 500 Flottweg machines sold in Indonesia in various applications.
about.t009: Decades of growth in North Sumatra
about.t011: Flottweg supplied its first Tricanters to a palm oil mill in North Sumatra. These Tricanters are still running until today, serving as the backbone of the mill’s operations for the past 40+ years.
about.t034: To manage our customers' needs, the company runs four dedicated departments: Sales, Technical Service, Workshop and Warehouse.
about.t003: A specialised engineering company that is always there for you

products.t026: Not sure which machine fits your mill?
products.t005: Flottweg delivered its first decanter in 1956 and has since become one of the world's leading decanter manufacturers. Its headquarters is in Vilsbiburg, near Munich. Unlike many competitors, Flottweg still designs, manufactures and assembles its machines in Germany, which is why they are known for reliability and durability.
products.t027: Our sales engineers understand both the machines and the applications they run in.

products.t007: In Indonesia since 1981, with the first machines still in operation

products.t012: With more than 55 years in the industry, Krebs is a world leader in cyclones and centrifugal slurry pumps, respected for innovative engineering and quality products. In 2007 Krebs joined the FLSmidth group and is now known as FLSmidth Krebs.
products.t013: We have worked with FLSmidth Krebs since 2006, supplying desanding cyclones to many major palm oil companies in Indonesia. First used in mining, Krebs gMAX desanding cyclones are known for separation efficiency, robustness, endurance and reliability.
products.t024: From Australia, Pel-Tec is a pioneer of Ripple Mill technology in palm oil mills in Indonesia, and one of our main principals.
products.t003: Separation and processing equipment from world-class principals, supplied and serviced locally.

divisions.t006: The Sales department's main task is to promote new machines to our customers. Beyond technical knowledge of the machines, our sales team understands the applications they will be used in, so every recommendation fits the process.
divisions.t017: A delay in servicing because parts are unavailable means longer downtime and real economic losses for our customers. Our warehouse keeps an adequate, sustainable stock of spare parts ready, in line with our commitment to excellent after-sales service.
divisions.t009: Our technicians and electricians commission and start up new machines, and provide after-sales service including on-site repairs and spare part installation. They are trained in-house, then continue with hands-on training at mills to learn the process flow of each application.
divisions.t020: Our workshop runs sophisticated machinery, including CNC lathes and computerised balancing machines.
